# Sorted Bars

Default sorted bar chart, descending by value.

```mdf-bar-chart,sort
key,value
Parser,18
Renderer,42
CLI,12
Packaging,7
Lua,15
```

Explicit descending horizontal alias.

```mdf-horizontal-bar-chart,sort=descending
key,value
North,3
South,21
East,8
West,13
Central,5
```

Ascending horizontal alias.

```mdf-bar-chart,sort=ascending
key,value
P0,89
P1,55
P2,34
P3,21
P4,13
P5,8
```

Explicit ascending horizontal alias.

```mdf-horizontal-bar-chart,sort=ascending
key,value
One,1
Two,2
Three,3
Four,4
Five,5
```
